senses.gloss:
r. 9th cl. (खौनाति)
1 To be past birth.
2 To cause or procure prosperity.
3 To produce purity, to purify.
4 To produce or manifest wealth.

f. (-ल्ली)
A parasitic plant.
E.
ख, and वल्ली a pedicle.

n. (-रि)
Rain water, dew, vapour, &c.
E.
ख heaven, and वारि water.

m. (-ष्पः)
Snow, hoar frost, dew.
E.
ख sky, and वाष्प vapour or tears.
